components.name: Primary action

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: A task-name field with visible label and source focus treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">任务名称<input class="ds-input" placeholder="这项工作要完成什么？" /></label>

components.name: Reader navigation
components.description: Active reader tab indicated by ink text and an underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:24px;min-height:43px;padding:0 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dce1e8);background:var(--surface,#fff)}.ds-tab{position:relative;border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted,#596575);font:400 12px/1.55 var(--font-ui, 'Collo Google Sans', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif);padding:0;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,120ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),color var(--motion-fast,120ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),border-color var(--motion-fast,120ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1))}.ds-tab[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--ink,#202630);font-weight:600}.ds-tab[aria-selected=true]::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;height:2px;background:var(--ink,#202630)}.ds-tab:active{background:var(--surface-hover,#edf0f5)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selected,#315bd6);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tab{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.css: .ds-work{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;min-height:64px;padding:8px 16px 11px;border:0;border-top:1px solid #b3c4ef;border-bottom:1px solid #c7d3ee;background:var(--selected-soft,#eef3ff);color:var(--ink,#202630);box-shadow:inset 1px 0 #b3c4ef,inset -1px 0 #b3c4ef;font-family:var(--font-ui, 'Collo Google Sans', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,120ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),color var(--motion-fast,120ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),border-color var(--motion-fast,120ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1))}.ds-work strong{display:block;font-size:14px;line-height:22px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-work span{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:11px;line-height:18px;color:var(--muted,#596575)}.ds-work:active{background:var(--surface-hover,#edf0f5)}.ds-work:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selected,#315bd6);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-work{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.name: Horizontal work option
components.description: B candidate chooser excerpt; selected paper surface and blue underline.
components.css: .ds-work-option{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;min-width:0;width:270px;min-height:86px;padding:12px 20px;border:0;border-left:1px solid var(--line,#dce1e8);border-right:1px solid var(--line,#dce1e8);background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#202630);font-family:var(--font-ui, 'Collo Google Sans', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,120ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),color var(--motion-fast,120ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),border-color var(--motion-fast,120ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1))}.ds-work-option::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;bottom:0;height:2px;background:var(--selected,#315bd6)}.ds-work-option span{font-size:11px}.ds-work-option strong{font-size:13px;font-weight:550;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-work-option:active{background:var(--surface-hover,#edf0f5)}.ds-work-option:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selected,#315bd6);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-work-option{transition:none;animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
This is a descriptive record of the finished isolated A/B browser fixture in `design-explorations/workbench-20261026`, awaiting the user's visual selection. The phrase above summarizes the implemented contract; it is not a user-approved brand metaphor. These tokens govern this preview only. Neither candidate is an approved global style or a production migration.

Neutral work surfaces, dark action controls and blue selection organize tasks and their supporting records. A exposes the complete filtered queue above the selected reader and diff. B puts a horizontal work chooser above a reader and evidence panel that fill the remaining height. They deliberately share visual primitives so the comparison concerns how work is organized.

Google Sans, the supplied peanut graphic and one consistent icon family remain confirmed commitments. The preview uses Phosphor. Its synthetic data, comments, drafts and state simulations are not evidence of native-window behavior, backend integration or real restoration. The independent desktop product requirement remains intact.
keyCharacteristics: Shared typography and state language across two different spatial candidates.
Reading surfaces and contextual evidence with restrained boundaries.
Visible selection, labeled statuses and explicit preview-only actions.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: A state color accompanies an icon, label or diff symbol; color alone does not establish task progress, delivery or backup status.

rules.name: The Reading Priority Rule
rules.body: Preserve the message and title hierarchy when adapting density. The preview's tiny ancillary labels are not a target body-text size.

rules.name: The Contextual Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation identifies transient layers; it does not separate every task or message into a raised card.

dos: **Do** keep Google Sans, the supplied peanut graphic and Phosphor consistent within this preview.
**Do** compare A and B using the same synthetic information and action meanings.
**Do** show selection, keyboard focus and state through more than a color change.
**Do** keep task progress, attribution, delivery and storage facts distinguishable in visual hierarchy.
**Do** treat this document as provisional until the user selects a visual direction.
donts: **Don't** promote these tokens or layouts into production routes before the selection gate.
**Don't** use the previously rejected warm reading-desk sample as an approved visual foundation.
**Don't** present a browser fixture as native desktop, connected collaboration or real recovery verification.
**Don't** infer Agent attribution or backup completion from proximity, color or a completed task.
